artists.biography: Gdańsk is a city on the Baltic coast of northern Poland, and the capital of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. With a population of 486,492, it is Poland's sixth-largest city and its major seaport. Gdańsk lies at the mouth of the Motława River and is situated at the southern edge of Gdańsk Bay, close to the city of Gdynia and the resort town of Sopot; these form a metropolitan area called the Tricity (Trójmiasto), with a population of approximately 1

perplexity.description:
Danzig is the debut studio album by American heavy metal band Danzig, released on August 30, 1988, and serves as the first release on producer Rick Rubin’s newly formed label, Def American Recordings (later renamed American Recordings). The album established the band’s signature sound, blending heavy, bluesy hard rock with gothic undertones, anchored by Glenn Danzig’s thick, Jim Morrison-esque vocals. Featuring ten tracks including the iconic “Mother” and “Twist of Cain,” the album showcases a raw, powerful energy that diverged from Danzig’s earlier horror punk work with The Misfits and Samhain, marking a pivotal evolution in his musical career .

The album remains Danzig’s best-selling work, achieving gold certification in the U.S. in 1994 and eventually reaching platinum status, a testament to its enduring impact on the heavy metal genre. American Recordings reissued the album in both the United States and United Kingdom in 1998, ensuring its continued availability to new generations of listeners. Notable details include the backwards Latin Catholic prayer at the start of “Possession” and the mysterious credit of “The Hunter” to Glenn Danzig despite its original composition by Albert King .

A recent 2026 black vinyl LP repress from American Recordings marks the first official vinyl reissue of the debut since its 1988 launch, featuring the full tracklist in a gatefold jacket with a printed inner sleeve . The album’s legacy is cemented not only by its commercial success but also by its role in launching Def American, a label that would become instrumental in shaping the sound of 1990s alternative and heavy music.
